commands.name: play
commands.en: Play a song, link, playlist or Spotify link, or add it to the queue
commands.zh: 播放歌曲、链接、歌单或 Spotify 链接，正在播放时加入队列

params.name: query
params.en: A song name, song link or playlist link
params.zh_desc: 歌名、歌曲链接或歌单链接

commands.name: search
commands.en: Search for songs and pick one to play
commands.zh: 搜索歌曲，从结果里选一首播放

params.name: query
params.en: A song name or artist to search for
params.zh_desc: 要搜索的歌名或歌手

commands.name: skip
commands.en: Skip the current song, or vote to skip it
commands.zh: 跳过当前歌曲，人多时发起投票

commands.name: pause
commands.en: Pause the music
commands.zh: 暂停播放

commands.name: resume
commands.en: Resume the music
commands.zh: 继续播放

commands.name: stop
commands.en: Stop the music, clear the queue and leave the voice channel
commands.zh: 停止播放、清空队列并离开语音频道

commands.name: nowplaying
commands.en: Show the song that is playing
commands.zh: 查看正在播放的歌曲

commands.name: queue
commands.en: Show the queue
commands.zh: 查看播放队列

params.name: page
params.en: Which page of the queue to show
params.zh_desc: 看第几页

commands.name: remove
commands.en: Remove a song from the queue
commands.zh: 从队列里移除一首歌

params.name: position
params.en: The song to remove; pick from the queue
params.zh_desc: 要移除的歌，可以从队列里选

commands.name: clear
commands.en: Clear the queue without stopping the current song
commands.zh: 清空播放队列，当前这首继续播

commands.name: shuffle
commands.en: Shuffle the queue
commands.zh: 随机打乱队列顺序

commands.name: loop
commands.en: Set the loop mode; leave empty to switch to the next mode
commands.zh: 设置循环模式，不填就切到下一种

params.name: mode
params.en: Off, repeat this song, or repeat the whole queue
params.zh_desc: 关闭、单曲循环或整个队列循环

commands.name: volume
commands.en: Show or set the volume, 0-150
commands.zh: 查看或调整音量，0–150

params.name: level
params.en: Volume in percent; 30-100 sounds best; leave empty to show it
params.zh_desc: 音量百分比，30–100 效果最好；不填就显示当前音量

commands.name: move
commands.en: Move a song to another place in the queue
commands.zh: 把队列里的一首歌挪到别的位置

params.name: from_pos
params.en: The song to move; pick from the queue
params.zh_desc: 要挪的歌，可以从队列里选

params.name: to_pos
params.en: Where to put it
params.zh_desc: 挪到第几位

commands.name: playlist save
commands.en: Save the current queue under a name
commands.zh: 把当前队列存成存档

params.name: name
params.en: A name for the saved queue; default is default
params.zh_desc: 存档的名字，默认 default

commands.name: playlist load
commands.en: Add a saved queue to the queue
commands.zh: 把一个存档加进播放队列

params.name: name
params.en: The saved queue to load; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要载入的存档，可以从列表里选

commands.name: playlist list
commands.en: List the saved queues
commands.zh: 查看已保存的存档

commands.name: playlist delete
commands.en: Delete a saved queue
commands.zh: 删除一个存档

params.name: name
params.en: The saved queue to delete; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要删除的存档，可以从列表里选

commands.name: join
commands.en: Have the bot join your voice channel
commands.zh: 让机器人加入你所在的语音频道

commands.name: rank
commands.en: Show a level card
commands.zh: 查看等级卡片

params.name: member
params.en: Whose card; default yours
params.zh_desc: 看谁的等级，默认是你自己

commands.name: leaderboard
commands.en: Show this server's level leaderboard
commands.zh: 查看这个服务器的等级排行榜

params.name: page
params.en: Which page to show
params.zh_desc: 看第几页

commands.name: welcome setup
commands.en: Pick the welcome and farewell channels and the auto roles
commands.zh: 选择欢迎频道、道别频道和新成员的自动身份组

commands.name: welcome test
commands.en: Preview the welcome message with yourself as the new member
commands.zh: 用你自己当新成员，预览欢迎消息

commands.name: giveaway start
commands.en: Start a giveaway in this channel
commands.zh: 在这个频道发起一个抽奖

params.name: duration
params.en: How long it runs, up to 365 days
params.zh_desc: 抽奖持续多久，最长 365 天

params.name: prize
params.en: What the winners get
params.zh_desc: 中奖者能得到什么

params.name: winners
params.en: How many winners, 1-20
params.zh_desc: 抽出几个人，1–20

commands.name: giveaway end
commands.en: End a running giveaway now
commands.zh: 提前结束一个进行中的抽奖

params.name: giveaway
params.en: The giveaway to end; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要结束的抽奖，可以从列表里选

commands.name: giveaway reroll
commands.en: Draw new winners for an ended giveaway
commands.zh: 给已结束的抽奖重新抽中奖者

params.name: giveaway
params.en: The ended giveaway; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 已结束的抽奖，可以从列表里选

params.name: count
params.en: How many new winners, 1-20
params.zh_desc: 重新抽几个人，1–20

commands.name: giveaway list
commands.en: List this server's recent giveaways
commands.zh: 查看这个服务器最近的抽奖

commands.name: roles list
commands.en: List this server's role panels
commands.zh: 列出这个服务器的身份组面板

commands.name: roles add
commands.en: Add a role button to a panel
commands.zh: 给面板加一个身份组按钮

params.name: panel
params.en: The panel to change; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要改的面板，可以从列表里选

params.name: emoji
params.en: The emoji on the button, such as 🎮
params.zh_desc: 按钮上的 emoji，比如 🎮

params.name: role
params.en: The role members get from the button
params.zh_desc: 成员点按钮领到的身份组

commands.name: roles remove
commands.en: Take a role button off a panel
commands.zh: 从面板上去掉一个身份组按钮

params.name: panel
params.en: The panel to change; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要改的面板，可以从列表里选

params.name: role
params.en: The role to take off; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要去掉的身份组，可以从列表里选

commands.name: roles exclusive
commands.en: Let members pick one role or several on a panel
commands.zh: 把面板切换成单选或多选

params.name: panel
params.en: The panel to change; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要改的面板，可以从列表里选

params.name: enabled
params.en: True lets members keep only one role
params.zh_desc: 选 True 就只能领一个，选 False 就能领多个

commands.name: roles delete
commands.en: Delete a role panel and its message
commands.zh: 删除一个身份组面板和它的消息

params.name: panel
params.en: The panel to delete; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要删除的面板，可以从列表里选

commands.name: kick
commands.en: Kick a member from the server
commands.zh: 把一名成员踢出服务器

params.name: member
params.en: The member to kick
params.zh_desc: 要踢出的成员

params.name: reason
params.en: Why they are kicked
params.zh_desc: 踢出的原因，会私信告诉对方

commands.name: ban
commands.en: Ban a member; add a duration for a temporary ban
commands.zh: 封禁一名成员，填了时长就是临时封禁

params.name: member
params.en: The member or user ID to ban
params.zh_desc: 要封禁的成员，也可以填用户 ID

params.name: duration
params.en: How long, such as 1d or 7d; leave empty to ban for good
params.zh_desc: 封禁多久，如 1d、7d；不填就是永久

params.name: delete_days
params.en: Also delete their messages from the last 0-7 days
params.zh_desc: 同时删除他最近几天发的消息，0–7 天

params.name: reason
params.en: Why they are banned
params.zh_desc: 封禁的原因，会私信告诉对方

commands.name: unban
commands.en: Lift a ban
commands.zh: 解除封禁

params.name: user
params.en: Who to unban; pick from the ban list or enter a user ID
params.zh_desc: 要解封的人，可以从封禁名单里选，也可以填用户 ID

params.name: reason
params.en: Why the ban is lifted
params.zh_desc: 解封的原因

commands.name: mute
commands.en: Time out a member
commands.zh: 禁言一名成员（Discord 超时）

params.name: member
params.en: The member to time out
params.zh_desc: 要禁言的成员

params.name: duration
params.en: How long, up to 28 days; default 10 minutes
params.zh_desc: 禁言多久，最长 28 天，默认 10 分钟

params.name: reason
params.en: Why they are timed out
params.zh_desc: 禁言的原因

commands.name: unmute
commands.en: Remove a member's timeout
commands.zh: 解除成员的禁言

params.name: member
params.en: The member to free
params.zh_desc: 要解除禁言的成员

params.name: reason
params.en: Why the timeout is removed
params.zh_desc: 解除的原因

commands.name: warn
commands.en: Warn a member; enough warnings trigger an automatic punishment
commands.zh: 警告一名成员，警告次数够了会自动处罚

params.name: member
params.en: The member to warn
params.zh_desc: 要警告的成员

params.name: reason
params.en: Why they are warned
params.zh_desc: 警告的原因，会私信告诉对方

commands.name: warnings list
commands.en: Show a member's warnings
commands.zh: 查看一名成员的警告记录

params.name: member
params.en: The member to look up
params.zh_desc: 要查看的成员

commands.name: warnings remove
commands.en: Delete one warning
commands.zh: 删除一条警告

params.name: warning
params.en: The warning to delete; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要删除的警告，可以从列表里选

commands.name: warnings clear
commands.en: Delete all of a member's warnings
commands.zh: 清空一名成员的所有警告

params.name: member
params.en: The member whose warnings are cleared
params.zh_desc: 要清空警告的成员

commands.name: purge
commands.en: Delete recent messages in this channel
commands.zh: 批量删除这个频道最近的消息

params.name: amount
params.en: How many messages, 1-500
params.zh_desc: 删除多少条，1–500

params.name: member
params.en: Only delete messages from this member
params.zh_desc: 只删除这个成员的消息（可选）

commands.name: slowmode
commands.en: Set slow mode for this channel
commands.zh: 设置这个频道的慢速模式

params.name: duration
params.en: Time between messages, up to 6 hours; 0 turns it off
params.zh_desc: 每条消息之间至少隔多久，最长 6 小时；填 0 关闭

commands.name: lock
commands.en: Stop members from sending messages in a channel
commands.zh: 锁定频道，普通成员不能发言

params.name: channel
params.en: The channel to lock; default this one
params.zh_desc: 要锁定的频道，默认当前频道

params.name: reason
params.en: Why it is locked
params.zh_desc: 锁定的原因

commands.name: unlock
commands.en: Let members send messages in a locked channel again
commands.zh: 解锁频道，恢复普通成员发言

params.name: channel
params.en: The channel to unlock; default this one
params.zh_desc: 要解锁的频道，默认当前频道

commands.name: case list
commands.en: List moderation cases, optionally for one member
commands.zh: 查看管理记录，可以只看一个成员的

params.name: member
params.en: Only show cases for this member
params.zh_desc: 只看这个成员的案件（可选）

params.name: page
params.en: Which page to show
params.zh_desc: 看第几页

commands.name: case view
commands.en: Show one case
commands.zh: 查看一个案件

params.name: case
params.en: The case to show; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要查看的案件，可以从列表里选

commands.name: case reason
commands.en: Change the reason of a case
commands.zh: 修改一个案件的原因

params.name: case
params.en: The case to change; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要修改的案件，可以从列表里选

params.name: reason
params.en: The new reason
params.zh_desc: 新的原因

commands.name: case duration
commands.en: Change how long an active timeout or temporary ban lasts
commands.zh: 修改还在生效的禁言或临时封禁的时长

params.name: case
params.en: The active timeout or temporary ban; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 还在生效的禁言或临时封禁，可以从列表里选

params.name: duration
params.en: The new length, counted from now
params.zh_desc: 新的时长，从现在算起

commands.name: automod status
commands.en: Show the automatic moderation settings
commands.zh: 查看自动审核的设置

commands.name: automod words add
commands.en: Add a banned word
commands.zh: 添加一个违禁词

params.name: word
params.en: The word to ban
params.zh_desc: 要禁止的词

commands.name: automod words remove
commands.en: Remove a banned word
commands.zh: 移除一个违禁词

params.name: word
params.en: The word to remove; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要移除的词，可以从列表里选

commands.name: automod words list
commands.en: Show the banned words
commands.zh: 查看违禁词

commands.name: automod whitelist add
commands.en: Allow links to a domain
commands.zh: 允许某个域名的链接

params.name: domain
params.en: A domain such as youtube.com
params.zh_desc: 如 youtube.com

commands.name: automod whitelist remove
commands.en: Stop allowing links to a domain
commands.zh: 不再允许某个域名的链接

params.name: domain
params.en: The domain to remove; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要移除的域名，可以从列表里选

commands.name: automod whitelist list
commands.en: Show the allowed domains
commands.zh: 查看允许的域名

commands.name: automod ignore add
commands.en: Skip a channel or role
commands.zh: 让自动审核跳过一个频道或身份组

params.name: channel
params.en: A channel to skip
params.zh_desc: 要跳过的频道

params.name: role
params.en: A role to skip
params.zh_desc: 要跳过的身份组

commands.name: automod ignore remove
commands.en: Stop skipping a channel or role
commands.zh: 不再跳过一个频道或身份组

params.name: channel
params.en: The channel to stop skipping
params.zh_desc: 不再跳过的频道

params.name: role
params.en: The role to stop skipping
params.zh_desc: 不再跳过的身份组

commands.name: automod ignore list
commands.en: Show the skipped channels and roles
commands.zh: 查看跳过的频道和身份组

commands.name: serverlog ignore
commands.en: Stop logging messages in a channel
commands.zh: 不再记录一个频道里的消息

params.name: channel
params.en: The channel to skip
params.zh_desc: 要忽略的频道

commands.name: serverlog unignore
commands.en: Log messages in a skipped channel again
commands.zh: 恢复记录一个频道里的消息

params.name: channel
params.en: The channel to log again
params.zh_desc: 要恢复记录的频道

commands.name: status
commands.en: Show how the bot is doing
commands.zh: 查看小凛的运行状态

commands.name: roll
commands.en: Roll a die
commands.zh: 掷一个骰子

params.name: sides
params.en: How many sides, 2-1000; default 6
params.zh_desc: 骰子有几个面，2–1000，默认 6

commands.name: avatar
commands.en: Show someone's avatar in full size
commands.zh: 查看某人的大图头像

params.name: member
params.en: Whose avatar; default yours
params.zh_desc: 看谁的头像，默认是你自己

commands.name: commands disable
commands.en: Turn a command off for this server
commands.zh: 在这个服务器停用一条指令

params.name: command
params.en: The command to turn off; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要停用的指令，可以从列表里选

commands.name: commands enable
commands.en: Turn a command back on
commands.zh: 重新启用一条指令

params.name: command
params.en: The command to turn on; pick from the list
params.zh_desc: 要启用的指令，可以从列表里选

commands.name: commands list
commands.en: Show the commands turned off here
commands.zh: 查看这个服务器停用了哪些指令

commands.name: help
commands.en: Open the command menu, or explain one command
commands.zh: 打开指令菜单，或者查看一条指令的用法

params.name: command
params.en: A command to explain, such as ban or warnings clear
params.zh_desc: 想了解的指令，如 ban、warnings clear
